title: Multi-Branch Transformer
abstract: arXiv:2611.19800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformer language models are commonly scaled by making their blocks wider or stacking them deeper. In this work, we explore a complementary path: branching, the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks. We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which processes the input through shared initial layers, executes independently parameterized branches of sequential blocks in parallel, and fuses their outputs before shared final layers. At comparable training compute, we study three MBT variants: Wide-Shallow preserves block width, Narrow-Deep preserves sequential depth, and Balanced interpolates between them. In controlled pretraining experiments at four mixture-of-experts scales (0.8B to 2.1B total parameters), 2-branch Wide-Shallow MBTs consistently outperform sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets. translated_abstract: Transformer语言模型通常通过加宽模块或堆叠更深层数来进行扩展。在这项工作中，我们探索了一条互补的路径：分支化，即完整Transformer模块的并行组合。我们提出了多分支Transformer（MBT），它通过共享的初始层处理输入，并行执行独立参数化的多个顺序模块分支，并在共享的最终层之前融合各分支的输出。在训练计算量相当的条件下，我们研究了三种MBT变体：宽-浅变体保持模块宽度不变，窄-深变体保持顺序深度不变，平衡变体则在两者之间进行折中。在四个专家混合规模的受控预训练实验中（总参数量从0.8B到2.1B），2分支的宽-浅MBT在匹配的参数量和训练计算量预算下始终优于顺序Transformer。平衡MBT的性能进一步提升，并且随着分支数量的增加仍保持相当的质量水平。
tldr: 提出多分支Transformer（MBT），通过并行组合完整Transformer模块的分支化路径来扩展模型，在匹配的参数量和训练计算量预算下始终优于传统的顺序堆叠Transformer。
en_tdlr: We introduce the Multi-Branch Transformer (MBT), which explores branching—the parallel composition of full Transformer blocks—as a complementary scaling path, and consistently outperforms sequential Transformers under matched parameter and training-compute budgets.
